name: CPU Usage vs Limit (cores)
description: container_cpu_usage_seconds_total (2-minute timeshift delta, not .rate() - see repo notes) vs kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource=cpu}.
programText:
raw = data('container_cpu_usage_seconds_total', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'kafka-0'))
((raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='Usage')
limit = data('kube_pod_container_resource_limits', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'kafka-0') and filter('resource', 'cpu') and filter('container', 'kafka'))
limit.publish(label='Limit')
